1.1.note: No pair-programming or collaborative-workflow content anywhere in the book. Taught continuously, through lab pair work and the Create Performance Task, not as a standalone lesson.

3.11.note: The book teaches linear search explicitly (chap07, named 'linear search' in the text) but never introduces binary search, even conceptually -- no `bisect`, no sorted-list halving example anywhere. Taught in the November algorithms block.

3.16.note: No dedicated simulation content in chapters 1-13; 'simulation' as a word only surfaces in chap19 (independent-study range, not this topic's natural home). chap12's random-number work is adjacent but not the same idea (generating text, not modeling a process). Taught in the November algorithms block.

3.17.note: No informal efficiency discussion (counting statement executions, comparing two algorithms for the same problem) appears anywhere in chapters 1-13. Occurrences of the word 'efficient' in the book are incidental, not this topic. Taught in the November algorithms block.

3.18.note: Not carried by this book at all; a conceptual, non-programming topic. Taught in the November algorithms block.
